The run returned by readRun is cloned once; both the original returned alias and the private clone are pinned. The clone supplies case, context fingerprint, manifest, skill receipt and stored review target to revalidation, so the caller review target remains only a consistency assertion.

Each authorization/cancel/interrupt callback captures binding identity, lease identity, kind and binding value digest. Prior scope predicates remain checked. Its positive boundary returns native-runtime-not-attached rather than asserting real native interruption.

The progress test attacks retained lifecycle run, output, current-run and discarded ready-return aliases after scope return. Current readSfAnalysisRun pins all these references and clones final egress; its source is byte-preserved. Both stored values and storageVersion must remain unchanged.

Existing stale observation/CAS handling, AlternativeDraft provenance, command cycles/digests, publication paths, egress pins, lifecycle fallback and prior cancellation/revocation tests are all outside the changed function or remain byte-identical.
